kaseya_vsa_agent_offline_trigger.description: Runs when an agent goes offline, with its machine, group and when it last checked in. Agents already offline when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and an agent starts it again each time it goes offline. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.agent_name: The agent's name, such as frontdesk-pc.root.acme.
output.first_check_in: When the agent first checked in.
output.last_check_in: When the agent last checked in.
output.last_logged_in_user: The last user to sign in to it.
output.operating_system: Its operating system, such as Windows.
output.org_id: The id of the agent's organization.
output.os_info: Its operating system's edition and build.
output.status: Whether it is online, offline, suspended or has never checked in.

parameters.description: Only agents in this machine group. Leave blank for every agent.
